name: demochat
description: A demo multi-client video conferencing web app built using django-channels and websockets for signalling and WebRTC for p2p connections, video and display streaming. More than 2 peers can be connected.

paragraphs: Vchat is a real-time video confrencing application built using webrtc and Socket.io, designed for seamless communication between users.
This project was made for learning how to signal WebRTC SDPs using Javascript WebSocket and django-channels to make multi-peer video conferencing systems.
features: Real-time Messaging: Instantaneous message delivery between users.
User Authentication: Simple username-based authentication for joining chats.
Typing Indicators: Displays when a user is typing a message.
Message History: Persists chat history for current session.
